name: test_exact_weyl.py
mathematical_scope: Weyl-covariance, scalar-calibration, NTT and tridiagonal-solver regressions over F_998244353.
input_and_guard_coverage: Tests n=8..4096, exact basis at n=8, seeded negative controls, one random solver and one additivity instance. Missing trial guard, empty/wrong-size outputs, nonlinear/stateful oracle, zero pivots, empty LU and adversarial-seed controls.
costs: 1+3t oracle calls per check; NTT control O(n log n), q-stage Green solve O(qtn), not a new Fourier implementation.
test_evidence: Direct n=8 DFT basis comparison and tridiagonal matrix-vector recovery are stronger independent controls; additivity at one pair does not certify arbitrary oracle linearity.
acceptance_boundary: Fixed-seed results are reproducible samples; the test that checks the probability-bound string does not establish independent uniform sampling.
findings: L43–45 tests only text containing the bound. L92–98 finite additivity test cannot discharge the fixed-linear-oracle contract.
